jarvis.description: Give JARVIS a task end-to-end (plan, act, verify)
jarvis.template:
Task for JARVIS: $ARGUMENTS

Plan the steps, execute them with the project's tools, and verify the result. Respect the permission gate: never bypass confirmation for deletion, money, external sends, or system changes.

research.description: Deep-dive research on a topic using web + local sources
research.template: Research this and return a concise brief with sources: $ARGUMENTS

desktop.description: Describe or control the desktop (screenshot, vision, click, type)
desktop.template:
Desktop task: $ARGUMENTS

Use vision (llava:7b via Ollama) to look at the screen, locate elements by description, and act via the input tools. pyautogui.FAILSAFE stays on.

health.description: Check brains, models, and system health
health.template: Run the health check: python -c "import llm_router; print(llm_router.health_report())" and report Ollama status (ollama list), reachable brains, and any missing models for: $ARGUMENTS

test.description: Run the pytest suite and summarise failures vs the known-failing baseline
test.template:
Run: python -m pytest tests/ -q --tb=no

Known-failing baseline (upstream, do NOT weaken gates to fix): tests/test_hardening.py (3 failures) and tests/test_core.py::test_agentic_brain_chains_actions. Report anything beyond the baseline. Focus: $ARGUMENTS
